\begin{tikzpicture}\begin{axis}[width=6.2cm,height=6.2cm,axis lines=middle,axis line style={-{Stealth}},xmin=-5,xmax=6,ymin=-5,ymax=5,xtick={-5,-4,...,6},ytick={-5,-4,...,5},grid=both,clip=false,scaled ticks=false,ticklabel style={font=\small,/pgf/number format/fixed},xlabel={$x$},ylabel={$y$}]\addplot[thick,blue,<->,domain=-5:6,samples=2] {-(3/4)*x};\addplot[only marks,mark=*,mark size=1.8pt] coordinates {(0,0) (4,-3)};\end{axis}\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
mastery.solution_text:
$c=0$
$m=\frac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}=\frac{-3}{4}=-\frac{3}{4}$
$y=-\frac{3}{4}x$
